sections.what: Settle the front-end module header contract: keep `@docs` as the gated module -> note edge, and demote `@powers` to optional prose (or make it a controlled field that must name a Feature Map label verbatim). Build the feature <-> module index from `@docs`, not from `@powers`.
sections.why: `@powers` is free-text prose (266 distinct strings across 156 modules) that `feature_index.py --check` pretends to check - a module can name the wrong feature and nothing catches it, because nothing runtime-linked reads it. `@docs` is a real path to a vault note and `js_module_index.py` already fails on a dead/folder target. The useful half is the join; the gate is theatre.
sections.how: Relax the `@powers` gate in `tools/feature_index.py`; source the feature->module reverse index from each module's `@docs` target. Regenerate `docs/design/feature-index.md`.
sections.verify:
1. `python tools/feature_index.py --check`.
   - expected: passes without the prose word-match.
   - observed: TODO
2. `python tools/feature_index.py --report`.
   - expected: feature -> modules built from `@docs`.
   - observed: TODO

acceptance.text: the `@powers` gate no longer fails on free prose
`@docs` remains the gated, checkable module -> note edge
the feature -> module join is built from `@docs`
